methodology.description: This dataset combines direct health signals already present in master-breeds.json with explicit breed rules, family-pattern rules, and structural/conformation risk rules. It is optimized for content, calculators, insurance UX, and breed health widgets rather than for diagnostic use.

evidence_levels.direct_source: Directly normalized from master-breeds ranking_data genetic ailment text.
evidence_levels.breed_specific_rule: Manually assigned from well-known breed-associated health patterns.
evidence_levels.family_pattern: Assigned from breed family, AKC group, or repeated phenotype pattern.
evidence_levels.structural_risk: Assigned from size, body shape, or preventive-care relevance.

methodology.important_note: Not every listed problem is a confirmed inherited disorder for every individual dog. Some rows include high-relevance monitoring risks used for practical care and insurance-facing content.
